propositions: Debug skill reads prior tickets but never writes back to them, creating a one-way-only dependency chain.
Step 7 sweep searches by construct pattern only and misses parity siblings that manifest as absences in parallel surfaces (CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, dual-direction).
Reporting lacks a structured disposition item for residual fragility and risk, allowing unexamined fragility to evaporate without tracking.

Own-tracker writebacks (RCA, summary, not-a-bug classification) must bypass approval gates when writing to the ticket's originating tracker, but the approval-gate paragraph contradicts this necessity.

Step 7's entry condition must use OR logic to trigger on either construct-pattern repetition (axis 1) or parallel-surface parity signatures (axis 2), with each axis running only when its condition is met.
